title: I'm a sucker for mobile bases
author: TashLai
selftext:
Don't mind the janky washed-out visuals and the terrible character shader. This was my "why not let Astra do it?" moment. Not sure if i'll keep it in game since i'll have to redesign like half of it but i thought it's just cool enough to show, plus it's giving me a little motion sickness.

There isn't much to say about the process, and i'm really not promoting the game here (not much to promote yet), except that textures are made by Astra working in Krita via MCP, brushstroke by brushstroke. The hut and the walking is a prototype i 3-shot with Astra to see if it can even be done in a manner that's not completely screwed up. It's kinda screwed up, but man it's cool and i'm a sucker for mobile bases.

comments.author: drnktgr
comments.body: How do you control where it walks

replies.author: TashLai
replies.body: Just command it to start walking in the direction the character is looking. Controls sure need polishing.
